AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY

15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
SEPTEMBER 26, 2023
06:30

9-26-23 Agenda
6:30 P.M. SPECIAL CLOSED SESSION
CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
At this time, only item(s) on the Closed Session agenda may be discussed in Public Comments.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation by Global Urban Strategies Regarding Social Media and Grant Updates
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Activity and Information Briefing
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. All speakers are requested to observe the City's Rules of Decorum when addressing the City Council. (LPMC section 2.04.120.)
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION DENOUNCING ANTISEMITISM AND CONDEMNING HATE CRIMES AND ALL OTHER FORMS OF RACISM, RELIGIOUS OR ETHNIC BIAS, DISCRIMINATION, INCITEMENT OF VIOLENCE, OR TARGETING A MINORITY (MAYOR KLINAKIS/MAYOR PRO TEM MUNOZ)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-5827 denouncing antisemitism and condemning hate crimes and all other forms of racism, religious or ethnic bias, discrimination, incitement of violence, or targeting a minority.
E-4 Antisemitism Staff Report
E-4 Antisemitism Attachment A Letter
E-4 Antisemitism Attachment B Resolution
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS - None
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT RESOLUTION NO. 23-5825
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 23-5825 approving Warrant Register No. 1560.
D-1 Warrant Resolution #1560
D-2
PRESENTATION OF AUGUST 2023 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-2 August Investment Report Staff Report
D-2 August Investment Report Attachments A-D Reports
D-3
PRESENTATION OF AUGUST 2023 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 August Requisition Summary Report Staff Report
D-3 August Requisition Summary Report Attachment A Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH UNITED RENTALS FOR THE PURCHASE OF A MOBILE GENERATOR AND UTILITY TRAILER TO BE USED THROUGHOUT THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase order contract with United Rentals for the purchase of a mobile generator and utility trailer; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-4 Generator Purchase United Rentals Staff Report
D-4 Generator Purchase United Rentals Attachment A Quote No. 224718647
D-4 Generator Purchase United Rentals Attachment B Quote No. 224718563
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION OF AUGUST 2023 BUDGET REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
E-1 August Budget Report Staff Report
E-1 August Budget Report Attachment A Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 8 (BUILDING REGULATIONS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER 8.50 SETTING FORTH PROCEDURES FOR AN EXPEDITED PERMIT PROCESS FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING SYSTEMS
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) waive reading of Ordinance No. 23-983 and read by title only; and (2) introduce Ordinance No. 23-983, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Title 8 (Building Regulations) of the La Puente Municipal Code adding Chapter 8.50 setting forth procedures for an expedited permit process for Electric Vehicle Charging Systems.
E-2 EV Charging Ordinance Staff Report
E-2 EV Charging Ordinance Attachment A Ordinance
E-2 EV Charging Ordinance Attachment B Checklist
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION NOMINATING A BOARD MEMBER TO THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-5826 nominating a Board Member to the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority.
E-3 WQA Board Member Nomination Staff Report
E-3 WQA Board Member Nomination Attachment A Letter
E-3 WQA Board Member Nomination Attachment B Resolution
E-5
UPDATE AND DISCUSSION REGARDING LA PUENTE PARK GRANTS, RESERVATIONS, LEAGUES, SPECIAL OLYMPICS, FIRE REGULATIONS, FEE STUDY, MAINTENANCE, PREPAREDNESS, AND OTHER ITEMS RELATED TO LA PUENTE PARK OPERATIONS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss this item and provide any necessary direction to Staff.
E-5 La Puente Park Operations Update Staff Report

AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
